plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 717 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.49833, -133.1173, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 39 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 2,024 m, about 987 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 100 m E of the spot at 820 m (59.27373, -132.58424). Water: unnamed wetland 80 m W (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Aug, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-26, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-16, closures 2026-10-16.
